issue_context.title: Detected blocking call to listdir inside the event loop by integration 'local_calendar'
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Blocking in the event loop detected
Maybe here: https://github.com/allenporter/ical/blob/64380cefb6942f75e76d725d1cf01ee39fe63b43/ical/util.py#L30

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2024.7.0dev

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Local_calendar

### Link to integration documentation on our website

_No response_

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Logger: homeassistant.util.loop
Quelle: util/loop.py:84
Erstmals aufgetreten: 18:39:01 (1 Vorkommnisse)
Zuletzt protokolliert: 18:39:01

Detected blocking call to listdir inside the event loop by integration 'local_calendar' at homeassistant/components/local_calendar/calendar.py, line 47: calendar = IcsCalendarStream.calendar_from_ics(ics) (offender: /usr/local/lib/python3.12/importlib/metadata/__init__.py, line 680: return os.listdir(self.root or '.')), please create a bug report at https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22integration%3A+local_calendar%22 Traceback (most recent call last): File "/home/vscode/.local/ha-venv/bin/hass", line 8, in <module> sys.exit(main()) File "/workspaces/core/homeassistant/__main__.py", line 209, in main exit_code = runner.run(runtime_conf) File "/workspaces/core/homeassistant/runner.py", line 190, in run return loop.run_until_complete(setup_and_run_hass(runtime_config)) File "/usr/local/lib/python3.12/asyncio/base_events.py", line 674, in run_until_complete self.run_forever() File "/usr/local/lib/python3.12/asyncio/base_events.py", line 641, in run_forever self._run_once() File "/usr/local/lib/python3.12/asyncio/base_events.py", line 1979, in _run_once handle._run() File "/usr/local/lib/python3.12/asyncio/events.py", line 88, in _run self._context.run(self._callback, *self._args) File "/workspaces/core/homeassistant/components/local_calendar/calendar.py", line 47, in async_setup_entry calendar = IcsCalendarStream.calendar_from_ics(ics)
```

review_comments: I guess it doesn't happen often enough to fix, but if [this is the cause](https://github.com/allenporter/ical/blob/64380cefb6942f75e76d725d1cf01ee39fe63b43/ical/util.py#L30-L32), why not push the call to `metadata` to be stored in a top level constant?

I considered moving that one, and may do that.  My assumption was there was also some stuff like https://github.com/allenporter/ical/blob/e46eb7329ac633d7e5002f67b4de57368d6e9007/ical/tzif/timezoneinfo.py#L75 given https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/118627 which shares the same code and so i didn't want to keep chasing this.

My take was: Home assistant is being pretty strict here -- so i'm putting the complexity in home assistant. (i get the motivation, it makes sense, just  hard to chase down the root cause since it can't be reproduced locally.
